title: Alkawal mo jibinaaka
intro: Yonta laaɓɗo waɗi fodoore ceniinde hade gargol cukalel. Daartol ngol limre ina feeñi e nder cuuɗi ceniiɗi, ɗo dewal hawrata e jaɓgol Alla. Holi oo maccucfo Alla?
clues: Mi jeyaa ko e galle teddinaaɗo e Quraana.
Mi waɗii alkawal mawngal ngam hokkude ɓiɗɗo am mo njibinaaka ngam gollal Alla.
Nde jibini mi, mi haawniima, tawi ko ɓiɗɗo debbo, hay so tawii miɗo sikki ko ɓiɗɗo gorko.
Mi inniri ɓiɗɗo am Maryam, innde hollitoore dewal e gollal.
Mi ɗaɓɓirii Alla ndeenka ɓiɗɗo am e iwdi mum e Seyɗaane kuddi.
Ɓiɗɗo am jaɓaama e juuɗe Joomiraawo, o waɗti ɗum e les njiimaandi Annabi Zakariya e nder suudu ceniindu.

trial.label: Ñaawoore/Kewu
options: Hunaare hokkugo ɓingel maako haa suudu dewal
Taƴde maayo e dow leydi njoorndi
trial.answer: Hunaare hokkugo ɓingel maako haa suudu dewal

location.label: Elemen keyɗo
options: Date ɗe o foofti les mum

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Ɓiyiiko jaɓaa, waɗtaa e les njiimaandi Annabi Zakariya
O rokkaa ɓiɗɗo gorko ina wiyee Yahya
Leñol makko halki ɗum ko henndu
O laati laamiiɗo dow laamu mawngu
outcome.answer: Ɓiyiiko jaɓaa, waɗtaa e les njiimaandi Annabi Zakariya

arabic: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًۭا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verse: [Mention, O Muḥammad], when the wife of ʿImrān said, "My Lord, indeed I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated [for Your service], so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing." (3:35)
